purpose: Close bounded classical and quantitative coverage gaps before model-family optimization without duplicating information already present in the V2 market baseline.

selection_contract.matched_control: same origins, target, model, costs, decision rule and primitive market features without the added issue448 family
selection_contract.trial_accounting: retain every attempted candidate including failures and held gates
selection_contract.multiplicity: bounded preregistered family grids; no post-result indicator mining
selection_contract.protected_boundary: no reserved confirmation, prospective paper, SIM, LIVE or post-2022 selection evidence
selection_contract.source_availability: A representation may use only strictly prior inner blocks with at least 504 purge-safe training rows and non-empty evaluation origins after PIT-safe preparation. Competing representations are selected on the chronological intersection of their supported prior blocks. Pre-source history is unavailable rather than backfilled.
selection_contract.minimum_training_rows_authority: config/phase2_market_only.json#execution_contract.minimum_training_rows, preserving the incremental-family semantics used by issues 426 and 455 rather than reverting to the earlier issue425 search minimum.

technical_analysis.credit_rule: A derived indicator receives credit only versus a matched primitive-feature ablation containing the underlying returns, ranges, moving-average gaps and volume primitives already available to V2.

range_breakout.note: Stochastic and Williams-style states share one normalized-range primitive and are not counted as independent information families.

market_structure.pit_rule: Use source publication timestamps; unavailable or ambiguous OI/positioning values fail closed rather than being backfilled.

open_interest_evaluation_lane.reason: PIT-safe OI has insufficient strictly prior history for the full 2017-2018 and 2019-2020 standard outer starts under the frozen 504-row family-layer minimum.
open_interest_evaluation_lane.parent_control_rule: Use the frozen issue425 selected configuration for the containing standard outer block; do not reselect the base market configuration.
open_interest_evaluation_lane.non_overlap_rule: The availability-aligned 2020 outer and the 2021-2022 outer are disjoint; each outer is scored once after representation selection on strictly prior supported inner blocks.
open_interest_evaluation_lane.matched_row_rule: Candidate and primitive control use identical OI-supported evaluation origins inside each OI outer.

storage_surprise_gate.target: actual WNGSR net change minus a timestamped pre-release market-consensus expectation
storage_surprise_gate.no_substitution: seasonal anomaly, prior-week change, model expectation, or post-release commentary must not be labelled market surprise

scheduled_event_timing.event: EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report
scheduled_event_timing.official_clock: Thursday 10:30 America/New_York with holiday exceptions resolved from the repository availability contract
scheduled_event_timing.execution_rule: No same-instant or HFT fill assumption; event state is usable only after the release is publicly available and before the strategy decision timestamp.

options_implied_gate.preflight_rule: Metadata and zero-spend feasibility checks precede any billable acquisition; options cannot block V2 completion.

dispositions.retain: positive matched marginal value that is not explained by the declared primitive ablation and remains defensible across chronological outer evidence
dispositions.hold: mechanism remains plausible but source/PIT/licensing/coverage/identifiability gate is not satisfied
dispositions.drop: bounded tested representation does not add matched marginal value
dispositions.downstream_only: requirement is registered for #427/#428/#430 but is not itself optimized in #448

rules: No #448 empirical family scoring starts before this preregistration exists in the governed change.
All data-dependent transforms are fit on training evidence only.
Indicator aliases that are algebraically equivalent share one search family rather than multiplying trials.
The current V2 market primitives remain in matched controls so derived indicators must demonstrate incremental value.
No storage consensus source is activated from isolated public articles or future-known consensus values.
No billable options acquisition is performed without a governed cost decision.
Failed and held candidates remain in the durable trial ledger.
V1 remains immutable and all post-2022 protected evidence remains unopened.
supersession_reason: No-scoring 2010-2022 source coverage audit proved PIT-safe open interest starts too late for the standard early outer blocks under the established 504-row incremental-family minimum; register an availability-aligned OI lane before any empirical family scoring.
